dimensions.mode: Selects exactly the requested mode and returns its artifact only.
dimensions.topology_decision: Chooses no_graph, loop, or graph from stated control needs and considers a simpler baseline.
dimensions.artifact_completeness: Includes the fields required by the selected output contract without unrelated artifacts.
dimensions.bounded_execution: Bounds retries, cycles, expansion, concurrency, cost, and time where applicable.
dimensions.state_correctness: Declares typed ownership, reducers or serialization, persistence, provenance, and migration where applicable.
dimensions.evidence_treatment: Separates observation, evidence, inference, verification, and authoritative outcome.
dimensions.security_controls: Uses trust labels, least privilege, bound approval, idempotency, and post-state verification in proportion to risk.
dimensions.ceremony: Does not impose graph or high-assurance machinery when it is unnecessary.

pass_rule: No mandatory dimension scores zero and total score is at least 13 of 16.
